sloka: कैकेय्यास्तु सुसंवृत्तम् क्षिप्रम् अद्य एव लक्ष्मण ।या न तुष्यति राज्येन पुत्रार्थे दीर्घ दर्शिनी ॥३-२-१९॥
transliteration: kaikeyyāstu susaṁvṛttam kṣipram adya eva lakṣmaṇa ।yā na tuṣyati rājyena putrārthe dīrgha darśinī ॥3-2-19॥

translations.english: Kaikeyi, my middle mother is farsighted indeed Not content with the kingdom alone see sent me, beloved of all beings, away to the forest. Let her cherished desire be fulfilled.
